name: novadde
description: NovaDDE, Geodesic Intelligence's AI co-scientist for drug discovery, as a Claude Code plugin: the deployment's own system prompt, the Model Platform's GPU models over MCP, the lab's science skills, and, in the interactive CLI, a watcher that tells you when a job finishes.

user_message_suffix.title: Per-message reminder
user_message_suffix.description: Text appended to every message you send, as a standing reminder to the agent. Empty by default, which is what the deployment ships.

read_only.title: Refuse job submission
read_only.description: Deny submit_job and submit_pipeline_run, so the agent can read the catalog and report on runs but cannot spend GPU time. Off by default, as on the deployment.
